@CreatedDate audit events AdvService->>AuditPort: captureCreation(id, snapshot, actorId) AuditPort->>AuditPort: compute snapshot JSON AuditPort->>AuditPort: insert INTO audit_log AuditPort->>AuditHook: on(ActionType.CREATE, ADVERTISEMENT, id) AuditHook->>AuditHook: enrichAdditionalInfo() AdvService-->>AdvImpl: Long id AdvImpl-->>AdvPort: Long id AdvPort-->>Handler: Long id Handler->>Handler: afterSave(true) Handler->>Handler: updateSession(fresh entity) Handler-->>UI: notify complete

diagrams.title: 4. Restore from Snapshot
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as UI
    participant AdvPort as AdvertisementPort
    participant AdvService as AdvertisementService
    participant AuditPort as DefaultAuditPort
    participant AuditRead as AuditReadService
    participant AuditRepo as AuditLogRepository
    
    UI->>UI: user clicks "restore to this snapshot"
    UI->>UI: gets snapshotId from activity feed
    
    UI->>AuditPort: getSnapshotContent(snapshotId, ADVERTISEMENT)
    
    AuditPort->>AuditRead: getSnapshotContent(snapshotId, entityType)
    AuditRead->>AuditRepo: SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE id=snapshotId
    
    AuditRepo-->>AuditRead: AuditLogProjection
    AuditRead-->>AuditPort: AuditSnapshotContentDto
    AuditPort-->>UI: snapshot (advertisement fields)
    
    Note over UI: Apply restored fields to entity
    
    UI->>AdvPort: save(restoreDto, actorId)
    AdvPort->>AdvService: save(dto, actorId)
    AdvService->>AdvService: UPDATE advertisement SET title=..., description=...
    
    Note over AdvService: Capture RESTORED action (ActionType.RESTORED)
    
    AdvService->>AuditPort: captureRestore(entityId, snapshot, actorId)
    AuditPort->>AuditRepo: INSERT INTO audit_log (action_type='RESTORED', snapshot_data={...})
    
    AdvService-->>AdvPort: entityId
    AdvPort-->>UI: success
    
    UI->>UI: reload entity, close restore dialog

sequenceDiagram participant SaveService as AdvertisementSaveService participant TaxonPort as TaxonPort participant TaxonImpl as DefaultTaxonPort participant AssignService as TaxonAssignmentService SaveService->>TaxonPort: replaceAssignments(ADVERTISEMENT, advId, taxonIds) TaxonPort->>TaxonImpl: (delegation) TaxonImpl->>AssignService: replaceAssignments(ADVERTISEMENT, advId, taxonIds, actorId) AssignService->>AssignService: load existing assignments AssignService->>AssignService: compute added/removed diff loop For each removed taxon AssignService->>AssignService: DELETE FROM taxon_assignment end loop For each added taxon AssignService->>AssignService: INSERT INTO taxon_assignment end AssignService-->>TaxonImpl: void TaxonImpl-->>TaxonPort: void TaxonPort-->>SaveService: void Note over SaveService: SaveService continues its own audit capture

diagrams.title: 8. Login and Registration Rate Limiting
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as LoginDialog
    participant Auth as AuthService
    participant Cache as loginAttempts (Caffeine)
    participant AuthMgr as AuthenticationManager

    UI->>Auth: login(email, password)
    Auth->>Cache: get(remoteAddr + "|" + email)
    alt attempts >= MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS (5)
        Auth-->>UI: throws IllegalStateException
        UI->>UI: show "too many login attempts" notification
    else under limit
        Auth->>AuthMgr: authenticate(email, password)
        alt BadCredentialsException
            Auth->>Cache: increment attempts
            Auth-->>UI: return false
            UI->>UI: show "invalid email or password" notification
        else success
            Auth->>Cache: invalidate(key)
            Auth-->>UI: return true
        end
    end

diagrams.title: 8. Login and Registration Rate Limiting
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as SignUpDialog
    participant Port as UserPort
    participant Impl as UserPortImpl
    participant Service as UserService
    participant Cache as registerAttempts (Caffeine)
    participant Repo as UserRepository

    UI->>Port: register(dto, request.getRemoteAddr())
    Port->>Impl: (delegation)
    Impl->>Service: register(dto, clientIp)
    Service->>Cache: get(clientIp)
    alt failures >= MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS (5)
        Service-->>Impl: throws IllegalStateException
        Impl-->>Port: (propagates)
        Port-->>UI: (propagates)
        UI->>UI: show "too many registration attempts" notification
    else under limit
        Service->>Repo: save(newUser)
        alt DuplicateKeyException (race with client-side email-uniqueness check)
            Service->>Cache: increment failures
            Service-->>UI: (propagates exception)
        else success
            Service-->>Impl: void
            Impl-->>Port: void
            Port-->>UI: void
            UI->>UI: show success notification
        end
    end

nodes.description: SQL filter/sort helper library (SqlFilterBuilder, OrderByBuilder)

intent.title: Renamed from query-starter to query-lib
Plain Java library — no Spring autoconfiguration
API scope frozen — no DSL extensions
Null-safe conditions — null filter value skips condition
`SqlOperator.ANY_OF` / `SqlCondition.anyOf(Set<Long>)` — a second `IN`-shaped operator, for id sets specifically
`anyOf`/`inSet` empty-input null (= "no restriction") must never back an access-narrowing predicate
`SqlCondition.like()` escapes `%`/`_`/`\` before wrapping

nodes.description: Testcontainers repository tests + fixtures for every starter (test-only, never shipped)

intent.title: One module owns every Testcontainers test — domain starters carry zero test code
Singleton Testcontainers Postgres container, shared across the whole `mvn test` run
Shared `.env` (`POSTGRES_IMAGE`) instead of a hardcoded image string
Sandbox-only env vars — `TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED` / `INTEGRATION_TESTS_POSTGRES_FIXED_PORT`
`jakarta.servlet-api` as a `provided`-scope dependency
Reusable test "steps" — `RepositoryTestSupport` / `TestDataCleaner`
`run.sh` auto-detects starter staleness instead of a manual skip-`-am` flag
Test package-private/private internal logic through its public entry point, never through a same-package trick or a widened production visibility
`@ImportAutoConfiguration` explicit allow-list instead of `@EnableAutoConfiguration` in shared test config
`@Tag("testcontainers")` on the shared base class + Surefire `excludedGroups`; `SharedEnvConfig` gains a testable overload
Explicit `junit-jupiter-api` compile-scope dependency — required for `AbstractPostgresIntegrationTest`'s `@Tag`

nodes.description: shared kernel: DTOs, domain events, SPI interfaces

intent.title: Package restructure — core / audit / attachment / user / advertisement
Package semantics — api vs spi vs dto
SPI naming convention — Port and Hook suffixes
Shared kernel — contracts only, no implementations
UserPort + AdvertisementPort for domain module extraction
ComponentFactory<T> — typed wrapper over ObjectProvider<T>
StorageService moved out of platform-commons into attachment-starter
AuditableSnapshot uses Id.NAME polymorphism; no subtype registration in starter
AuditableSnapshot.isRestorable() default method
Attachment lifecycle — SPI ports replace ApplicationEvents
Audit decoupled from attachment via AuditActivityEnrichHook
Starters inject hooks as required beans; marketplace uses ObjectProvider
User-domain knowledge purged; actor-centric naming
Activity decoration via SPI (AuditUiPort + AuditActivityRowHook)
MediaSummary reclassified as DTO
Role and ownership checks exposed via UserPort
Taxon SPI contracts added — TaxonPort and TaxonAuditHook
ActionType.RESTORED — explicit enum value for soft-delete restore
version parameter added to AdvertisementPort.delete() and TaxonPort.update()/softDelete()
`AuditTimelineFilterDto.actorId` (`Long`) → `actorIds` (`Set<Long>`)
`AuditTimelineItemDto.expandedChanges()` — a narrow, documented exception to "`*.dto` has no behavior"
Dead SPI parameters and methods removed — `AuditPort`, `AuditActivityEnrichHook`, `AuditDomainHook`, `UserPort`, `AttachmentPort`
`Class<T> targetClass` type-token added to `AuditPort.getSnapshotContent()` / `AuditDomainHook.castIfKnown()`
Snapshot schema versioning — a real `schemaVersion` field everywhere, no reflection
Batch G governance cleanup — DTO boundary, Hook→Port rename, UserIdMarker package
One starter, multiple `*Port` interfaces — `UserPort` split into 4 (improvement-124 Batch A2)
`ProviderProfilePort` added — F-04 Batch 124-B, `provider-profile-spring-boot-starter`

nodes.description: audit subsystem: write + read side (auto-configured starter)

intent.title: Module structure — single starter, write + read side combined
SQL coupling to domain tables removed via SPI batch pattern
Full decoupling from advertisement domain
Starter owns `auditObjectMapper` with @Qualifier; audit.enabled removed
Actor-centric SPI vocabulary; user-domain types purged
AuditActivityFieldsHook SPI — expanded field display in activity feed
Action badge — two CSS classes (base + modifier)
Restore semantics — getSnapshotContent is the restore source
Jackson Id.NAME + subtype registration in marketplace JacksonConfig
Audit decoupled from attachment via AuditActivityEnrichHook
SPI consolidation — 3 always-co-implemented pairs merged
Repository — findRows + findForActivity replace domain-coupled UNION
findByActor — correlated subqueries replace window-function scan
changes_summary removed — diff computed dynamically on read
Generic AuditLogProjection — one repository DTO for history and activity
i18n consolidated into marketplace-app; no starter properties files
`audit.changes.*` field-label namespace convention
AuditHistoryRowActionsHook — cancelled
AuditReadService direct injection in marketplace UI panels is correct
id tiebreaker in SQL window functions for deterministic versioning
withSameTypePrevSnapshot — in-memory same-type diff post-processing
restorableCount replaces items.size() for restore button visibility
Top-level Timeline tab replaces inline timeline tabs
captureRestore() — dedicated method for restore audit events
`AuditAutoConfiguration` self-registers `CleanupProperties`

keyServices: `DefaultAuditPort` — entry point for all audit operations
`AuditReadService` — query audit_log, build activity feeds, timeline queries
Diffs are computed at read time by `AuditReadService` via `AuditableSnapshot.diff()` on snapshot pairs — no separate diff service or field-marker annotation exists
contracts: `AuditPort` — marketplace calls starter to capture events and query history
`AuditDomainHook` — marketplace tells audit about domain-specific events and owners
`AuditActivityFieldsHook` — marketplace supplies human-readable field labels for each entity type
`AuditActivityEnrichHook` — marketplace merges related activities (e.g., media changes with advertisement changes)

nodes.description: photo/attachment module + S3 storage (auto-configured starter)

intent.title: Attachment domain logic extracted from marketplace-app
S3 storage merged into this module; storage-s3-starter deleted
Decoupled from advertisement domain — generic over EntityType
StorageService internalized; attachment.enabled property removed
Starter owns `attachmentObjectMapper` with @Qualifier
Actor-centric public API; user-domain naming purged
Symmetry with audit-starter — package rename, i18n enum, port via @Component
IFrame sandbox attribute on all video embeds
Vaadin IFrame src patching via Page.executeJs
marketplace-app attachment UI imports starter internals directly
`AttachmentService` closes upload `InputStream`s explicitly; `AttachmentCleanupService` gains a DB-cross-checked orphan sweep for entity-folder S3 files
`AttachmentSnapshotRepository.extractUrls()` reads the `attachment_urls` array via `Array.getResultSet()` — no cast at all, not even to `Object[]`
`AttachmentSnapshotService` resolves real filenames from `attachment.filename` by url, instead of deriving a display name from the S3 object key
`AttachmentVideoUtil` extracted from `AttachmentService`; video/embed classification consolidated onto `AttachmentMediaContentType`

keyServices: `AttachmentService` — upload, delete, query, snapshot management
`StorageService` — S3-compatible backend (minIO in dev, AWS in prod)
`AttachmentRepository` — CRUD + queries by entity
`AttachmentCleanupJob` — scheduled orphan cleanup using `CleanupProperties`
contracts: `AttachmentPort` — marketplace calls starter for file operations
`AttachmentAuditPort` — request audit records for media snapshots

nodes.description: User domain: entity, service, security, UserPortImpl (auto-configured starter)
keyServices: `UserService` — CRUD, role management, first-user promotion to ADMIN
`UserSettingsService` — per-user settings (locale, pagination defaults)
`UserRepository` — custom queries (find by email, role-based filters)
`UserPrincipal` — Spring Security integration
contracts: `UserPort` — marketplace calls starter to manage users
`UserSettingsChangedHook` — marketplace resets pagination defaults when settings change; implemented by `SettingsPaginationService`
`AuthenticatedPrincipal` — type contract for Spring Security principals

nodes.description: Advertisement domain: entity, service, AdvertisementPortImpl (auto-configured starter)
keyServices: `AdvertisementService` — create, update, delete, ownership checks, soft-delete
`AdvertisementRepository` — CRUD + filtered/sorted queries via query-lib
contracts: `AdvertisementPort` — marketplace calls starter for CRUD + filtering
`AdvertisementActivityFieldsHook` — marketplace enriches audit activity with advertisement field labels

nodes.description: Taxonomy domain: taxon/category/tag management, TaxonPort (auto-configured starter)

intent.title: Filter resolves through `Set<Long>`, not SQL JOIN
DefaultTaxonPort is a coordination layer, not pure delegation
TaxonType enum is a closed set in platform-commons
TaxonAuditHook fires per assignment change, not per batch
`TaxonRepository.findByIds()` now returns soft-deleted rows too

entities: `Taxon` entity (table: `taxon`) — soft-deletable; optional stable `code` per type
keyServices: `TaxonService` — CRUD taxon entries, soft-delete/restore, translation management
`TaxonAssignmentService` — assign/unassign taxons to entities, batched lookup, usage counts
`DefaultTaxonPort` — coordination layer: resolves translations, filters active records, builds DTOs (not pure delegation)
`TaxonFilter` — internal value object for repository filter conditions (active / all / deleted)
`TaxonProperties` — configurable `defaultLocale` for translation fallback
contracts: `TaxonPort` (`platform-commons`) — marketplace calls starter for CRUD, assignment management, and batched queries

nodes.description: Provider profile domain: MASTER/SHOP/SUPPORT catalog entries, ProviderProfilePort (auto-configured starter)
keyServices: `ProviderProfileService` — create/update, delete (real `DELETE`, no soft-delete), enforces
`ProviderProfileEnrichmentService` — category/city/actor enrichment on read
contracts: `ProviderProfilePort` — marketplace calls starter for CRUD + filtering

nodes.description: main Vaadin application (all UI)

intent.title: All Vaadin UI consolidated in marketplace-app
No JPA / no Hibernate — JdbcClient + inline SQL
Inline SQL repository style — no descriptor layer
Dependency versions
Modular storage — contract in attachment-starter, not marketplace
Audit subsystem in audit-spring-boot-starter; domain calls via AuditPort
@EnableMethodSecurity active; @PreAuthorize not at class level on services
Double-click guard on save buttons via setEnabled
ValidRange.List without @Constraint; ValidRangeValidator caches field lookups
Restore semantics — restore TO snapshot, not BEFORE snapshot
OverlayFormBinder used directly — no AuditUiPort
No shared UI module — plain-class pattern for future sharing
AbstractViewOverlayModeHandler — template method for view overlays; tab machinery has since moved to AbstractFormOverlayModeHandler
Audit writes belong in the service layer, not the UI
*HookImpl — no snapshot inspection, pure delegation
Full user decoupling — marketplace no longer imports org.ost.user.* internals
Decoupling debt at the time of writing — all items since resolved
Top-level Timeline tab
Taxon/Category domain extracted as standalone starter
AbstractEntityOverlay<H> — currentFormHandler and save/cancel lifecycle in base class
QuillEditor — custom Vaadin web component for rich-text editing
isCurrentState — criteria for "Current state" badge vs Restore button
TransactionTemplate orchestrator — preferred pattern for multi-step backend operations
Jsoup-based, defense-in-depth description length validation
Deny-by-default at the Spring Security URL layer is incompatible with this app's Vaadin routing model
Rate limiting counts only real failures, never successful attempts
forward-headers-strategy so registration rate limiting sees the real client IP
SettingsPaginationService — per-user ownership on bindings, detach-based cleanup
Optimistic locking via a stored version column — no auto-reload on conflict
Field labels applied uniformly across every Activity/Timeline rendering path
QuillEditor character counter measures visible text; DB column sized to the raw-HTML cap, not the visible-text cap
Request correlation id via SLF4J MDC, plus closing silent-service logging gaps
Optional-port UI components use `ComponentFactory<Port>`, never `@ConditionalOnBean` on the component class
No raw cross-starter SQL joins — bulk-lookup port + service-level enrichment; actor-reference columns follow Taxon's naming convention
`advertisement` stores no denormalized attachment columns — media summary enriched at read time via a bulk `AttachmentPort` lookup
`AdvertisementRepository.buildIdClause()` binds a plain array, not a `Set`, for the category-filter id list
Raw `new Button(...)` spots converted to `Ui*Button` wrappers — every consumer is itself a bean injecting its own factory, never a pre-built widget through a constructor
Theme CSS colors tokenized into named custom properties — fixes the WCAG AA contrast failure and builds the prerequisite dark-mode needs
Maven Enforcer — dependency hygiene enforced at build time, starter-to-starter ban activated per-starter not at the root
`NotificationService`'s close button converted to `UiIconButton` despite being a plain `@Service`, not a Vaadin bean
ArchUnit codifies cross-module architecture rules — lives in `marketplace-app/src/test`, not a new module
`UserPickerField` gains an offset-based lookup (`OffsetPageable`) instead of deriving a page number from Vaadin's raw offset
Timeline tab resolves category names via a typed `prevSnapshotData` on `AuditTimelineItemDto`; `ChangeEntry.replaceIfField()` consolidates the one unavoidable type check
`UserSettingsRepository` optimistic-locking version lives inside the `settings` JSONB blob, not a new SQL column
New `QueryLongField` (text-backed) replaces `NumberField` (`Double`-backed) for the user id range filter — neither Vaadin numeric field type actually fits a `Long`

`AbstractFormOverlayModeHandler.buildContentWithActivity()` unifies the Edit/Activity tab choreography across Advertisement/Taxon/User form handlers; fixes `UserFormOverlayModeHandler`'s viewer/subject `userId` bug
`AdvertisementSaveService.save()` moves the attachment-gallery commit to just before the transaction's own commit; logs loudly if it rolls back after the S3 move anyway
`UserPickerField` rewritten from `CustomField<UserDto>` (single value) to `CustomField<Set<UserDto>>` (chip list) for the Timeline actor filter
`I18nKey` stays one consolidated enum — domain-split considered and rejected
Advertisement delete-side audit capture moves into `AdvertisementSaveService`, matching save's existing orchestration
User deletion — soft-delete, cascade to the user's own ads, retention purge, actor-name annotation
Leaf UI buttons converted from `@SpringComponent` prototype beans to plain classes (Batch 1)
Leaf UI fields converted from `@SpringComponent` prototype beans to plain classes (Batch 2)
Structural leaf components (`EmptyStateView`, `DialogLayout`, `OverlayLayout`) converted to plain classes (Batch 3); `PaginationBar` deliberately kept a Spring bean
`ConfirmActionDialog` converted to a plain class (Batch 4, final) — closes improvement-025; unrelated Playwright flake fixed in `fillActorPicker`'s search path
`ui/query/elements/*` leaf UI components converted from `@SpringComponent` prototype beans to plain classes — sibling refactor to improvement-025, applied to the query/filter-bar tree
`AbstractViewOverlayModeHandler`'s secondary/tertiary-tab machinery removed — dead since the Timeline-tab extraction
`UiComponentFactory<T>` bounded to `T extends Configurable<T, ?>`; non-`Configurable` consumers migrated to plain `ComponentFactory<T>`
F-01 deep links + Open Graph meta tags — step 1 (prototype gate)
F-01 "Share" button — native Web Share API with clipboard-copy fallback
F-01 `sitemap.xml` — paginated port scan, Caffeine-cached; `deploy.sh` now sets `APP_PUBLIC_URL`
F-01 remaining items — `twitter:card` fix, `og:image` cache-busting, JSON-LD, History API sync
List stability after edit — splice-in-place instead of full refresh (Advertisement, User, Taxon)
`advertisement` → `user_information` hard FK coupling removed — last one between starters
F-02 city dictionary + geo filter — `TaxonType.CITY` reusing the existing taxon assignment mechanism, no schema change
F-03 listing types (Offer/Request/Product) — new `ad_kind` column, `RadioButtonGroup` (first use in this codebase), multi-select filter
Activity/restore moved from an "Activity" tab to a stacked nested overlay (improvement-128)
`findById()` locale fix + `AdvertisementEnrichmentService` extraction (improvement-132 Batch A)
`user-spring-boot-starter` doc fix + `User.toDto()` dedup + `@NonNull` sweep (improvement-132 Batch C)
F-04 Batch A — `locale`/`settings` split out of `user_information` into `user_preferences` (improvement-124)
`UserDto.locale` removed, `UserProfileUpdate` renamed, `UserPort` split (improvement-124 Batch A2)
`EntityType.PROVIDER_PROFILE` compiler-forced touches (improvement-124 Batch 124-B)
